description: Lists and removes the OAuth tokens Thunderbird keeps for one issuer.

functions.name: list
functions.description: Returns the saved refresh tokens for the issuer, without their values.

functions.name: clear
functions.description: Removes the issuer's tokens from memory and the password manager, and drops open connections.

parameters.name: hostnames
parameters.description: Mail server host names that use the issuer (oauth_provider.hostnames).

parameters.name: portalHost
parameters.description: If given, also removes Thunderbird's cookies for this host, so the next sign-in asks for credentials.
